items.arabic: بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.

translation.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies
translation.ar: الاستعاذة من شر كل خلقة ومن شر الليل إذا أظلم — مع النفث في الكفين ومسح الجسد.

virtues.en: Part of the nightly blow-and-wipe the Prophet ﷺ never left (Bukhari 5017).
virtues.ar: من النفث الذي كان النبي ﷺ لا يدعه كل ليلة (البخاري 5017).

items.arabic: بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.

translation.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind The Sovereign of mankind The God of mankind From the evil of the retreating whisperer Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind From among the jinn and mankind
translation.ar: الاستعاذة من شر الوسواس — مع النفث في الكفين ومسح الجسد.

virtues.en: Part of the nightly blow-and-wipe the Prophet ﷺ never left (Bukhari 5017).
virtues.ar: من النفث الذي كان النبي ﷺ لا يدعه كل ليلة (البخاري 5017).

items.arabic: بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ لَآ أَعۡبُدُ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٞ مَّا عَبَدتُّمۡ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ لَكُمۡ دِينُكُمۡ وَلِيَ دِينِ
items.transliteration: Qul ya ayyuhal-kafirun. La a'budu ma ta'budun. Wa la antum 'abiduna ma a'bud. Wa la ana 'abidum-ma 'abadtum. Wa la antum 'abiduna ma a'bud. Lakum dinukum wa liya din.

translation.en: Say, "O disbelievers I do not worship what you worship Nor are you worshippers of what I worship Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship For you is your religion, and for me is my religion
translation.ar: سورة الكافرون — من السنة قراءتها قبل النوم إعلاناً للبراءة من الشرك.

reference.narrator: Nawfal ibn Mu'awiyah / Farwah ibn Nawfal
reference.notes: Also narrated in Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3403; graded hasan by al-Albani.

virtues.en: One of the surahs the Prophet ﷺ would recite before sleeping (Tirmidhi 3402; Ahmad; sahih).
virtues.ar: من السور التي كان النبي ﷺ يقرأها قبل النوم (الترمذي 3402، وأحمد، صحيح).

items.notes: Narrated by Farwah ibn Nawfal, from his father.

items.arabic: بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗاۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٖۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٖ ثُمَّ ٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنقَلِبۡ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئٗا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٞ وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا رُجُومٗا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ إِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ فِيهَا سَمِعُواْ لَهَا شَهِيقٗا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلۡقِيَ فِيهَا فَوۡجٞ سَأَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٞ فَكَذَّبۡنَا وَقُلۡنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ كَبِيرٖ وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ كُنَّا نَسۡمَعُ أَوۡ نَعۡقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ فَٱعۡتَرَفُواْ بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسُحۡقٗا لِّأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٞ كَبِيرٞ وَأَسِرُّواْ قَوۡلَكُمۡ أَوِ ٱجۡهَرُواْ بِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ ذَلُولٗا فَٱمۡشُواْ فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِهِۦۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ أَمۡ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبٗاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيرِ وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٖ وَيَقۡبِضۡنَۚ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءِۭ بَصِيرٌ أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ جُندٞ لَّكُمۡ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ إِنِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَرۡزُقُكُمۡ إِنۡ أَمۡسَكَ رِزۡقَهُۥۚ بَل لَّجُّواْ فِي عُتُوّٖ وَنُفُورٍ أَفَمَن يَمۡشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦٓ أَهۡدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمۡشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ زُلۡفَةٗ سِيٓـَٔتۡ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَهۡلَكَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوۡ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرٗا فَمَن يَأۡتِيكُم بِمَآءٖ مَّعِينِۭ
items.transliteration: (Transliteration omitted for the full surah — the Arabic text is complete above; read it directly from the Mushaf text.)

translation.en: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water
translation.ar: سورة الملك كاملة (ثلاثون آية) — تُقرأ قبل النوم؛ من قرأها كل ليلة كان له بها شفاعة وشفاعة حتى يُغفر له.

reference.notes: Qur'an text extracted verbatim from the app's own corpus — the previous record contained only verse 1 and is now the complete surah.

virtues.en: 'A surah of thirty verses interceded for a man until he was forgiven — it is Surah Tabarak' (Tirmidhi 2891, hasan; Abu Dawud 1400).
virtues.ar: «سورة من القرآن ثلاثون آية شفعت لرجل حتى غُفر له، وهي سورة تبارك الذي بيده الملك» (الترمذي 2891، حسن؛ وأبو داود 1400).

items.notes: Full surah (67:1-30) should be recited from the Mushaf; only the opening verse is reproduced here.

title.ar: اللهم قني عذابك يوم تبعث عبادك

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak.

translation.en: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
translation.ar: اللهم قني عذابك يوم تبعث عبادك — ثلاث مرات عند النوم.

reference.notes: The Prophet ﷺ said it three times when he went to bed.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said it three times when he went to bed (Abu Dawud 5056, sahih).
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ إذا أراد أن ينام وضع يده اليمنى تحت خده ثم قال ثلاثاً: «اللهم قني عذابك يوم تبعث عبادك» (أبو داود 5056، صحيح).

items.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma wada'tu jambi, wa bika arfa'uh, fa-in amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi 'ibadakas-salihin.

translation.en: In Your name, O Allah, I lay myself down and by Your leave I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; and if You send it back, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
translation.ar: بسمك اللهم وضعت جنبي، وبك أرفعه، فإن أمسكت نفسي فارحمها، وإن أرسلتها فاحفظها بما تحفظ به عبادك الصالحين.

reference.notes: The Prophet's ﷺ instruction for lying on the right side.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: when you go to your bed, perform wudu as for prayer, lie on your right side, and say the dua above (Bukhari 6320).
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: إذا أتيت مضجعك فتوضأ وضوءك للصلاة، ثم اضجع على شقك الأيمن، وقل: بسمك اللهم وضعت جنبي وبك أرفعه (البخاري 6320).

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallah.

translation.en: Glory is to Allah.
translation.ar: سبحان الله — ثلاثاً وثلاثين عند النوم.

virtues.en: Part of the Fatimah dhikr the Prophet ﷺ taught: before sleeping, glorify thirty-three, praise thirty-three, magnify thirty-four (Bukhari 3113; Muslim 2727).
virtues.ar: من تسبیح فاطمة رضي الله عنها الذي علّمها النبي ﷺ: تسبحين ثلاثاً وثلاثين وتحمدین ثلاثاً وثلاثين وتكبرین أربعًا وثلاثين عند نومك (البخاري 3113، مسلم 2727).

items.notes: Narrated by Ali bin Abi Talib.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah.
translation.ar: الحمد لله — ثلاثاً وثلاثين عند النوم.

virtues.en: Part of the bedtime dhikr taught to Fatimah and Ali (Bukhari 3113; Muslim 2727).
virtues.ar: من ذكر النوم الذي علّمه النبي ﷺ لفاطمة وعليّ (البخاري 3113، مسلم 2727).

items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar.

translation.en: Allah is the Most Great.
translation.ar: الله أكبر — أربعًا وثلاثين عند النوم.

virtues.en: 'That is better for you than a servant' — the Prophet's ﷺ words to Ali and Fatimah (Bukhari 3113).
virtues.ar: «ذلك خير لكما من خادم» — كلام النبي ﷺ لعليّ وفاطمة (البخاري 3113).

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa alja'tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalt, wa binabiyyikal-ladhi arsalt.

translation.en: O Allah, I submit myself to You, I entrust my affairs to You, I turn my back to You, seeking Your reward and fearing Your punishment. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book that You revealed and in Your Prophet that You sent.
translation.ar: اللهم أسلمت نفسي إليك، وفوضت أمري إليك، وألجأت ظهري إليك، رغبةً ورهبةً إليك، لا ملجأ ولا منجاً منك إلا إليك، آمنت بكتابك الذي أنزلت وبنبيك الذي أرسلت.

reference.notes: Said before sleeping; if one dies that night, dies upon the fitrah.

virtues.en: 'If you die that night you will die upon the natural disposition' — and it is the last words of the sleeping person (Bukhari 247).
virtues.ar: «إن مت من ليلتك مت على الفطرة» — وهي آخر كلام النائم (البخاري 247).

title.en: Last Two Ayat of Surah Al-Baqarah (Before Sleep)

items.arabic: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيۡنَ أَحَدٖ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦۚ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۖ غُفۡرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا مَا ٱكۡتَسَبَتۡۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوۡ أَخۡطَأۡنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡنَآ إِصۡرٗا كَمَا حَمَلۡتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦۖ وَٱعۡفُ عَنَّا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَآۚ أَنتَ مَوۡلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

translation.en: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people
translation.ar: الآيتان الأخيرتان من سورة البقرة — من قرأهما في ليلة كفتاه بأذن الله من كل شر.

reference.book: Book of the Virtues of the Qur'an
reference.notes: Qur'an text extracted verbatim from the app's own corpus — replaces the transliteration-only placeholder record.

virtues.en: Whoever recites the last two verses of al-Baqarah in a night, they will suffice him (Bukhari 5009; Muslim 808).
virtues.ar: من قرأ الآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلة كفتاه (البخاري 5009، مسلم 808).

title.ar: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات — عند حلول الليل

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ، مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَذَرَأَ، وَبَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ طَوَارِقِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammatil-lati la yujawizuhunna barrun wa la fajir, min sharri ma khalaq, wa sharri nafsi, wa sharrish-shayatini wa ma yahdurun.

translation.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah — which neither the righteous nor the wicked can transgress — from the evil of what He created, from the evil of my soul, and from the evil of the devils and their presence.
translation.ar: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات التي لا يجاوزهن برّ ولا فاجر، من شر ما خلق، ومن شر نفسه، ومن شر الشياطين وما يحضرون — من قل بها حين يحول إلى فراشه لم تمسه حتى يقوم.

reference.notes: Moved from the morning list to its canonical place: said when the night arrives.

virtues.en: 'Whoever says it when he goes to his bed will not be touched by a devil until morning' (Muslim 2710 for the shorter wording; Abu Dawud 5063).
virtues.ar: «فلم تمسه حتى يصبح حُمة ولا سُمّة» (مسلم 2710 للصيغة القصيرة؛ وأبو داود 5063).

title.en: The Dua Upon a Disturbing Dream

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَىٰ وَمُنزِّلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ
items.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim wa min sharri hazhihir-ru'ya. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri ma ra'aytu wa min sharri ma na'amu, wa la yadurruni ma ra'aytu wa la yadurruna ma ra'aytu.

translation.en: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed, and from the evil of this dream. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I saw and from the evil of what I may see; may what I saw not harm me nor anyone else.
translation.ar: أعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم ومن شر هذه الرؤيا: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من شر ما رأيت ومن شر ما نعَم، ولا يضرني ما رأيت ولا يضرنا ما رأيت — ثم يتفل عن شماله ثلاثاً ولا يحدّث بها أحداً.

reference.notes: From Abu Qatadah: the good dream is from Allah; the disturbing one is from Satan — spit three times to the left and do not tell anyone.

virtues.en: Spit three times to your left, seek refuge from Satan, and do not tell anyone about it — then it cannot harm you (Muslim 2262).
virtues.ar: ينفث عن يساره ثلاثاً ويستعيذ بالله من الشيطان ومن شر ما رأى ولا يحدّث بها أحداً فلا يضره (مسلم 2262).

description.en: Gratitude for a new morning, said as you wake.
description.ar: شكر نعمة البعث والصباح عند الاستيقاظ.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the resurrection.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعد ما أماتنا وإليه النشور.

reference.notes: The Prophet's ﷺ words upon waking from sleep.

virtues.en: The Prophet's ﷺ words when he woke at night (Bukhari 6312).
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ إذا استيقظ من الليل قال: «الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعد ما أماتنا وإليه النشور» (البخاري 6312).

title.ar: الحمد لله الذي رد عليّ روحي

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi radda 'alayya ruhi, wa 'afani fi jasadi, wa adhina li bidhikrih.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who returned my soul to me, granted me well-being in my body, and permitted me to remember Him.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي رد عليّ روحي وعافاني في جسدي وأذن لي بذكره.

reference.notes: Said upon waking from sleep; graded sahih.

virtues.en: The Prophet's ﷺ remembrance upon waking (Tirmidhi 3401, sahih).
virtues.ar: من أذكار النبي ﷺ عند الاستيقاظ من النوم (الترمذي 3401، صحيح).

title.ar: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك (عند الاستيقاظ)

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.

translation.en: There is no deity except You; glory be to You. Indeed, I was among the wrongdoers.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين.

reference.notes: Answered whenever a Muslim supplicates with it.

virtues.en: 'No Muslim ever supplicates with it for anything except that Allah answers him' (Tirmidhi 3505, sahih).
virtues.ar: «ما دعا بها مسلم في شيء إلا استجاب الله له» (الترمذي 3505، صحيح).

title.ar: اللهم لك الحمد أنت نور السماوات (قيام الليل)

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيَّامُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ لَكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ، وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَلِقَاؤُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ حَقٌّ، وَالسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur. Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta nurus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinna, wa lakal-hamdu anta qawamus-samawati wal-ard, wa lakal-hamdu antal-haqqu wa wa'dukal-haqqu wa liqa'uka haqqun, wa qawluka haqqun, wal-jannatu haqqun, wan-naru haqqun, wan-nabiyyuna haqqun, wa Muhammadun ﷺ haqqun, was-sa'atu haqqun. Allahumma laka aslamtu, wa bika amantu, wa 'alayka tawakkalt, wa ilayka anabt, wa bika khasamt. Allahumma innaka antal-haqq, faghfir li, waghfir li dhunubi, innaka antal-Ghafurur-Rahim.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after taking it, and to Him is the resurrection. O Allah, to You is all praise — You are the light of the heavens and the earth and all within them; to You is all praise — You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth; to You is all praise — You are the Truth, Your promise is true, the meeting with You is true, Your word is true, Paradise is true, the Fire is true, the Prophets are true, Muhammad ﷺ is true, and the Hour is true. O Allah, to You I submit, in You I believe, upon You I rely, to You I return, and with You I dispute. O Allah, You are the Truth, so forgive me and forgive me my sins. You are the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعد ما أماتنا وإليه النشور، اللهم لك الحمد أنت نور السماوات والأرض ومن فيهن، ولك الحمد أنت قوام السماوات والأرض، ولك الحمد أنت الحق ووعدك الحق ولقاؤك حق وقولك حق والجنة حق والنار حق والنبيون حق ومحمد ﷺ حق والساعة حق، اللهم لك أسلمت وبك آمنت وعليك توكلت وإليك أنبت وبك خاصمت، اللهم أنت الحق فاغفر لي واغفر لي ذنوبي إنك أنت الغفور الرحيم.

reference.notes: The Prophet's ﷺ long remembrance when he woke at night; moved here from the morning list where it was misplaced.

virtues.en: When the Prophet ﷺ woke at night he would say this (Bukhari 6312).
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ إذا قام من الليل قال هذا الذكر (البخاري 6312).

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Alhamdulillah, wa subhanallah, wa la ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. Allahumma-ghfir li, aw qadara 'alayya.

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things competent. Praise is to Allah, glory is to Allah, there is no deity except Allah, Allah is the Most Great, and there is no power nor strength except by Allah. Then: O Allah, forgive me — or whatever he said.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير، الحمد لله، وسبحان الله، ولا إله إلا الله والله أكبر، ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله، ثم دعا: اللهم اغفر لي أو ما شاء.

reference.notes: Whoever wakes at night and says this, then supplicates, is forgiven.

virtues.en: Whoever wakes at night and says these words, then supplicates, is forgiven; and if he performs wudu and prays, his prayer is accepted (Bukhari 1154).
virtues.ar: من تعار من الليل فقال هذه الكلمات ثم دعا غُفر له، وإن توضأ وصلّى قبلت صلاته (البخاري 1154).

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallah.

translation.en: Glory is to Allah.
translation.ar: سبحان الله — ثلاثاً وثلاثين عند تعارّ الليل.

virtues.en: Part of the night-waking dhikr (Ibn Majah 3882; sahih).
virtues.ar: من ذكر التعارّ من الليل (ابن ماجه 3882، صحيح).

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah.
translation.ar: الحمد لله — ثلاثاً وثلاثين عند تعارّ الليل.

virtues.en: Part of the night-waking dhikr (Ibn Majah 3882; sahih).
virtues.ar: من ذكر التعارّ من الليل (ابن ماجه 3882، صحيح).

items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar.

translation.en: Allah is the Most Great.
translation.ar: الله أكبر — أربعًا وثلاثين عند تعارّ الليل.

virtues.en: Completes the hundred with the tahlil (Ibn Majah 3882; sahih).
virtues.ar: يتم بها المائة مع التهليل (ابن ماجه 3882، صحيح).

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
items.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim, wa min sharri ma ra'ayt. La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhal-yawm wa khayra ma ba'dah, wa a'udhu bika min sharri hadhal-yawm wa sharri ma ba'dah.

translation.en: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed, and from the evil of what I saw. There is no deity except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things competent. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it.
translation.ar: أعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم ومن شر ما رأيت، لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير، اللهم إني أسألك خير هذا اليوم وخير ما بعده وأعوذ بك من شر هذا اليوم وشر ما بعده.

reference.notes: One who wakes frightened: seek refuge from Satan and do not narrate the dream.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: a good dream is from Allah; if one wakes frightened, let him seek refuge and not tell anyone — then it cannot harm him (Muslim 2263).
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: الرؤيا الصالحة من الله، فإذا استيقظ أحدكم مفزوعاً فليقل: أعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم ومن شر ما رأى، فلا يحدّث بها أحداً فلا يضره (مسلم 2263).

description.en: Tasbih, tahmid, and beloved dhikr for any time.
description.ar: تسبيح وتحميد وأذكار مأثورة في كل وقت.

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih, subhanallahil-'Azim.

translation.en: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him; glory is to Allah the Almighty.
translation.ar: سبحان الله وبحمده، سبحان الله العظيم.

reference.notes: Also Muslim 2694 with the weighing of the scales.

virtues.en: 'Two words light upon the tongue, heavy in the scales, beloved to the Most Merciful' (Bukhari 6682; Muslim 2694).
virtues.ar: «كلمتان خفيفتان على اللسان، ثقيلتان في الميزان، حبيبتان إلى الرحمن» (البخاري 6682، مسلم 2694).

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar.

translation.en: Glory is to Allah, and all praise is for Allah, and there is no deity except Allah, and Allah is the Most Great.
translation.ar: سبحان الله، والحمد لله، ولا إله إلا الله، والله أكبر.

reference.notes: 'The most beloved of speech to Allah are four.'

virtues.en: 'The most beloved of speech to Allah are four' (Muslim 2137).
virtues.ar: «أحب الكلام إلى الله أربع» (مسلم 2137).

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things competent.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير — مائة مرة، وهي عدل عشر رقاب.

virtues.en: A hundred times equals freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds, a hundred sins erased, and protection from Satan that day (Bukhari 3293; Muslim 2691).
virtues.ar: مائة مرة: عدل عشر رقاب وكتبت له مائة حسنة ومحيت عنه مائة سيئة وكانت له حرزاً من الشيطان يومه ذلك (البخاري 3293، مسلم 2691).

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih, 'adada khalqih, wa rida nafsih, wa zinata 'arshih, wa midada kalimatih.

translation.en: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him — by the number of His creation, by His pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the ink of His words.
translation.ar: سبحان الله وبحمده عدد خلقه ورضا نفسه وزنة عرشه ومداد كلماته — ثلاثاً تُرجح الجلسات الطوال.

virtues.en: Outweighs hours of dhikr, as the Prophet ﷺ taught Juwayriyah (Muslim 2726).
virtues.ar: تُرجح الجلسات الطوال كما علّم النبي ﷺ جويرية (مسلم 2726).

title.en: La Hawla wa La Quwwata Illa Billah
title.ar: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله

items.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.

translation.en: There is no power and no strength except with Allah.
translation.ar: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله — كنز من كنوز الجنة.

reference.notes: Muslim 2704: 'Shall I not tell you of a word… it is a treasure from the treasures of Paradise.'

virtues.en: 'A treasure from the treasures of Paradise' (Bukhari 6384; Muslim 2704).
virtues.ar: «كنز من كنوز الجنة» (البخاري 6384، مسلم 2704).

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad.

translation.en: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
translation.ar: اللهم صل وسلم على نبينا محمد.

reference.notes: 'Whoever sends one prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.'

virtues.en: 'Whoever sends one prayer upon me, Allah sends ten mercies upon him' (Muslim 408).
virtues.ar: «من صلى عليّ صلاة صلى الله عليه بها عشراً» (مسلم 408).

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid. Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad, kama barakta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

translation.en: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim — You are indeed Praiseworthy, Most Noble. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim — You are indeed Praiseworthy, Most Noble.
translation.ar: اللهم صل على محمد وعلى آل محمد كما صليت على إبراهيم وعلى آل إبراهيم إنك حميد مجيد، واللهم بارك على محمد وعلى آل محمد كما باركت على إبراهيم وعلى آل إبراهيم إنك حميد مجيد.

reference.notes: The complete tashahhud salawat the Prophet ﷺ taught after the Companions asked how to bless him.

virtues.en: The formula the Prophet ﷺ taught when the Companions asked how to send prayers upon him (Bukhari 3370).
virtues.ar: الصيغة التي علّمها النبي ﷺ لما سأل الصحابة عن كيفية الصلاة عليه (البخاري 3370).

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi

translation.en: Glory be to Allah and all praise is due to Him

virtues.en: His sins are forgiven even if they were like the foam of the sea (Muslim 2692).
virtues.ar: غُفرت ذنوبه ولو كانت مثل زبد البحر (مسلم 2692).

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullah

translation.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ sought forgiveness more than seventy times a day (Bukhari 6307).
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يستغفر في اليوم أكثر من سبعين مرة (البخاري 6307).

items.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
items.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil.

translation.en: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
translation.ar: حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل — قول إبراهيم عليه السلام حين أُلقي في النار.

virtues.en: The words of Ibrahim when he was cast into the fire, and of Muhammad ﷺ when it was said the people had gathered against him (Bukhari 6263).
virtues.ar: قالها إبراهيم عليه السلام حين أُلقي في النار، وقالها محمد ﷺ حين قيل إن الناس قد جمعوا لكم فاخشوهم فأعادهم الله بالمن والسلم (البخاري 6263).

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.

translation.en: There is no deity except You; glory be to You. Indeed, I was among the wrongdoers.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين — كانت تُدعى بها دعوة ذي النون.

virtues.en: Sa'd said: the Prophet ﷺ said no Muslim supplicates with it except that he is answered (Tirmidhi 3505, sahih).
virtues.ar: قال سعد: سمعت النبي ﷺ يقول: «ما دعا بها مسلم في شيء إلا استجاب الله له» (الترمذي 3505، صحيح).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
items.transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'Afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni.

translation.en: O Allah, You are the Pardoner and You love pardon, so pardon me.
translation.ar: اللهم أنك عفو تحب العفو فاعفو عني.

reference.notes: The dua Aishah asked for Laylatul Qadr; beneficial to say anytime.

virtues.en: The dua for Laylatul Qadr (Tirmidhi 3513; Ibn Majah 3850; sahih) — and a beloved dua at every time.
virtues.ar: دعاء ليلة القدر (الترمذي 3513، ابن ماجه 3850، صحيح) — ومحبوبة في كل وقت.

items.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma.

translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
translation.ar: رب زدني علماً — قولٌ قرآني دعاءً، تُقال في طلب العلم.

reference.notes: A Qur'anic dua; the Companions and scholars would repeat it when asking for knowledge.

virtues.en: A Qur'anic dua commanded by Allah's word (Ta-Ha 114).
virtues.ar: دعاء قرآني أمر الله به في كتابه (طه 114).

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-'alamin.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah, Lord of all worlds.
translation.ar: الحمد لله رب العالمين — نصف الميزان.

reference.notes: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Praise fills the scales' (Muslim 223).

virtues.en: 'Alhamdulillah fills the scales' (Muslim 223).
virtues.ar: «الحمد لله تملأ الميزان» (مسلم 223).

title.en: Allahu Akbaru Kabira wal-Hamdu Lillahi Kathira
title.ar: الله أكبر كبيرا والحمد لله كثيرا

items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
items.transliteration: Allahu akbaru kabira, wal-hamdu lillahi kathira, wa subhanallahi bukratan wa asila.

translation.en: Allah is the Most Great, greatly great; abundant praise is for Allah; and glory is to Allah morning and evening.
translation.ar: الله أكبر كبيرا، والحمد لله كثيرا، وسبحان الله بكرتا وأصيلا — من الكلام الطيب الطاهر الذي يُقال في الصباح.

reference.notes: Among the 'pure, wholesome words' to say in the morning.

virtues.en: Among the kalimat tayyibah the Prophet ﷺ taught for the morning (Muslim 2728).
virtues.ar: من الكلمات الطيب التي علّمها النبي ﷺ للصباح (مسلم 2728).

items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathira, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta, faghfir li maghfiratan min 'indik, warhamni, innaka antal-Ghafurur-Rahim.

translation.en: My Lord, I have wronged myself greatly, and none forgives sins except You; so grant me forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy on me. Indeed, You are the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
translation.ar: رب إني ظلمت نفسي ظلماً كثيراً ولا يغفر الذنوب إلا أنت فاغفر لي مغفرة من عندك وارحمني إنك أنت الغفور الرحيم.

reference.notes: The Prophet ﷺ taught Abu Bakr this dua.

virtues.en: The Prophet's ﷺ teaching to Abu Bakr (Bukhari 6306).
virtues.ar: تعليم النبي ﷺ لأبي بكر (البخاري 6306).

title.ar: استغفر الله الذي لا إله إلا هو

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullahal-ladhi la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum wa atubu ilayh.

translation.en: I seek forgiveness from Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer — and I turn to Him in repentance.
translation.ar: أستغفر الله الذي لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم وأتوب إليه.

reference.notes: His sins are forgiven even if he fled from jihad; graded sahih.

virtues.en: Whoever says it, his sins are forgiven even if he fled from the battlefield (Abu Dawud 1517, sahih).
virtues.ar: من قالها غُفرت ذنوبه ولو فرّ من الحرب (أبو داود 1517، صحيح).

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullahal-'Azim wa atubu ilayh.

translation.en: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Almighty and turn to Him in repentance.
translation.ar: أستغفر الله العظيم وأتوب إليه.

reference.notes: The Prophet's ﷺ daily istighfar exceeded seventy times.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ sought forgiveness more than seventy times a day (Bukhari 6307).
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يستغفر أكثر من سبعين مرة في اليوم (البخاري 6307).

title.en: La Hawla wa La Quwwata Illa Billahil-'Aliyyil-'Azim
title.ar: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله العلي العظيم

items.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'Aliyyil-'Azim.

translation.en: There is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great.
translation.ar: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله العلي العظيم — كنز من كنوز الجنة.

reference.book: Book of the Virtues of Medina
reference.notes: Muslim 2704 calls it a treasure of Paradise.

virtues.en: A treasure from the treasures of Paradise (Bukhari 1887; Muslim 2704).
virtues.ar: كنز من كنوز الجنة (البخاري 1887، مسلم 2704).

title.ar: اللهم إني أسألك الجنة وأعوذ بك من النار

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannah, wa a'udhu bika minan-nar.

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أسألك الجنة وأعوذ بك من النار — تقال عند التقائع بين الصلوات.

reference.notes: The Prophet's ﷺ dua when two people met; graded sahih.

virtues.en: The Prophet's ﷺ dua when two Muslims met (Abu Dawud 5600, sahih).
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ إذا التقى الرجلان من أصحابه قال: «اللهم إني أسألك الجنة وأعوذ بك من النار» (أبو داود 5600، صحيح).

description.en: Duas for the ordinary moments of an ordinary day.
description.ar: أدعية لأحوال اليوم العادية: الطعام، والخروج، واللباس…

title.ar: التهليل عند الاستيقاظ من النوم بالليل

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadeer, subhanAllah, walhamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is over all things competent. Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is no deity except Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever wakes up at night and says this, then supplicates, his supplication will be answered. If he makes wudu and prays, his prayer will be accepted.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik

translation.en: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.

virtues.en: A short but powerful supplication to seek Allah's mercy upon entering the house of Allah.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.

virtues.en: Upon leaving the mosque, one asks Allah for His boundless favor and grace.

title.en: Praying Two Rak'ahs Upon Entering the Mosque (Tahiyyatul Masjid)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu `ala rasulillah, Allahummaghfir li dhunubi waftah li abwaba rahmatik

translation.en: In the name of Allah, and blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, forgive my sins and open the gates of Your mercy for me.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: When one of you enters the mosque, let him pray two rak'ahs before sitting down. (Sahih al-Bukhari 444, Sahih Muslim 714)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah

translation.en: In the name of Allah.

virtues.en: Beginning wudu with Bismillah is a sunnah. There is no valid wudu without mentioning the name of Allah according to some scholars.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
items.transliteration: Allahummaj'alni minat-tawwabin waj'alni minal-mutatahhirin

translation.en: O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves.

virtues.en: A beautiful dua asking Allah to make one steadfast in repentance and purification. Graded Hasan by at-Tirmidhi, Sahih by Al-Albani.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
items.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa `ala rabbina tawakkalna

translation.en: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we exit, and upon our Lord we rely.

virtues.en: A sunnah of mentioning Allah when entering and exiting one's home, showing reliance on Allah in all affairs.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi, tawakkaltu `alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

translation.en: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: When a man leaves his house and says Bismillah, tawakkaltu `alallah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, it is said to him: You are guided, sufficed, and protected. The Shaytan becomes distant from him. (Sunan Abi Dawud 5095, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3426)

items.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
items.transliteration: As-salamu `alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh

translation.en: Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) instructed Anas to greet his family with salam when entering the home. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5893)

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi kasani hadhath-thawba wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or might of my own.

virtues.en: An expression of gratitude acknowledging that all provision comes from Allah alone, not from one's own efforts.

title.en: Dua for Blessing in New Clothes

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهُ وَخَيْرَ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtanihi, as'aluka khayrahu wa khayra ma suni'a lah, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lah

translation.en: O Allah, all praise is for You, for You are the One who has clothed me. I ask You for its good and the good of that for which it was made, and I seek Your refuge from its evil and the evil of that for which it was made.

virtues.en: A comprehensive dua that seeks the good and seeks protection from any harm in what one wears. Graded Hasan by at-Tirmidhi, Sahih by Al-Albani.

title.en: Dua When Looking in the Mirror

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ كَمَا أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي فَأَحْسِنْ خُلُقِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma kama ahsanta khalqi fa ahsin khuluqi

translation.en: O Allah, just as You have made my external appearance good, make my character good.

reference.collection: Musnad Ahmad 6/155, graded Sahih by Al-Albani

virtues.en: This beautiful dua connects outward beauty with inner character, reminding us that good character is the true beauty in the sight of Allah.

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alna muslimeen

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims.

virtues.en: A comprehensive expression of gratitude for food, drink, and the blessing of Islam.

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًىٰ عَنْهُ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarkan fih, ghayra makfiyyin wa la muwadda'in wa la mustaghna `anhu

translation.en: All praise is for Allah, a praise that is abundant, pure, and full of blessings — a praise that is neither insufficient nor abandoned, and which we can never be without.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) ate with a group and when he finished he said: Indeed, a servant of Allah ate food and praised Allah for it and was given a full reward. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5458, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3459)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba'ith

translation.en: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female devils.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: When any of you enters the toilet, he should say Bismillah and seek refuge from the devils. (Sahih al-Bukhari 142, Sahih Muslim 375)

items.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
items.transliteration: Ghufranak

translation.en: I seek Your forgiveness.

virtues.en: A short expression of seeking Allah's forgiveness after leaving the bathroom, thanking Him for the blessing of removal of harm. (Sunan Abi Dawud 30)

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah

translation.en: All praise is for Allah.

virtues.en: When a person sneezes, they should say Alhamdulillah, praising Allah who has revived them after every sneeze (which is like a small death). The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Allah likes the act of sneezing and dislikes the act of yawning. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6223, Sahih Muslim 2991)

items.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: Yarhamukallahu

translation.en: May Allah have mercy upon you.

virtues.en: When someone sneezes and says Alhamdulillah, the one who hears it should reply: Yarhamukallahu (May Allah have mercy on you). The sneezer then replies: Yahdikumullah wa yuslihu balakum (May Allah guide you and rectify your affairs). (Sahih al-Bukhari 6223, Sahih Muslim 2991)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllahilladhi yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal-mala'ikatu min kheefatihi

translation.en: Glory be to the One whom thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels out of fear of Him.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would say this when hearing thunder. He would also say: This is a severe warning to the people of the earth. (Muwatta Malik, Sunan Abi Dawud 5099)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'an

translation.en: O Allah, make it a beneficial rain.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would say this when he saw rain falling, asking Allah to make it a source of benefit and blessing. (Sahih al-Bukhari 1032)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, subhanAllahilladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun

translation.en: In the name of Allah. Glory be to the One who has subjugated this for us, though we could not have subjugated it by ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we will return.

virtues.en: This dua, derived from the Quran (43:13-14), is recited upon boarding any form of transport, acknowledging that the ability to travel is from Allah. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3446, Sunan Abi Dawud 2602)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ، اَللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanAllahilladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun, Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda, Allahumma hawwin `alayna safarana hadha watwi `anna bu'dah, Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safari wal-khalifatu fil-ahli, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safari wa ka'abatil-manzari wa su'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahli

translation.en: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to the One who has subjugated this for us, though we could not have subjugated it, and indeed to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You in this journey of ours for righteousness, piety, and deeds that are pleasing to You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Successor over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, from a gloomy sight, and from a bad outcome regarding wealth and family.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would say this upon mounting his riding animal for travel. (Sahih Muslim 2722)

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumit, wa huwa hayyun la yamut, biyadihil-khayr, wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadeer

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is the Ever-Living who never dies. In His hand is all good, and He is over all things competent.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever enters the market and says this, Allah will record for him a million good deeds, erase a million bad deeds, and raise him by a million ranks. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3428)

title.en: Dua Between the Adhan and the Iqamah

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah was-salatil-qa'imah, ati Muhammadan wasilata wafadilah, wab'athhu maqaman mahmudan alladhi wa'adtah.

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the established prayer, grant Muhammad the Wasilah (a station in Paradise) and the Fadilah (a rank above all creation), and raise him to the praised station which You have promised him.
translation.ar: اللهم رب هذه الدعوة التامة والصلاة القائمة آت محمداً الوسيلة والفضيلة وابعثه مقاماً محموداً الذي وعدته

virtues.en: The dua said between the adhan and the iqamah is not refused — 'so say it' (Tirmidhi 3689; Abu Dawud 521; sahih).
virtues.ar: الدعاء بين الأذان والإقامة لا يُرَدّ، قال النبي ﷺ: «فادعوا» (الترمذي 3689، أبو داود 521، صحيح).

items.notes: Moved from the post-prayer category — its canonical place is between the adhan and the iqamah (Tirmidhi 3689: the dua is not refused).

items.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun insha Allah

translation.en: No harm, it is a purification, if Allah wills.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would visit the sick and say these comforting words, reminding them that illness is a means of expiation for sins. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5652, Sahih Muslim 2192)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِهِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabban-nas, adhhibil-ba's, ishfi wa antash-shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uka, shifa'an la yughadiru saqaman

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the affliction. Heal him, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing — a healing that leaves no illness.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would visit the sick, place his hand on the sick person's forehead and say this dua seven times. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5651, Sahih Muslim 2191)

items.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اَللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
items.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un, Allahumma'jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha

translation.en: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and compensate me with something better.

virtues.en: The promise of Allah: 'Give glad tidings to the patient' (al-Baqarah 155-157) — this is the dua of the one struck by calamity.
virtues.ar: وعد الله: «بشر الصابرين» (البقرة 155-157) — دعاء المصاب بالبلاء كما علم النبي ﷺ أم سلمة.

items.notes: Aishah narrated: the Prophet ﷺ said whoever says this at a calamity, Allah gives him better in exchange (Muslim 918).

items.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَىٰ، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَاصْبِرْ وَاحْتَسِبْ
items.transliteration: Inna lillahi ma akhadha wa lahu ma a'ta, wa kullu shay'in `indahu bi-ajalin musamma, fasbir wahtasib

translation.en: Indeed, to Allah belongs what He has taken, and to Him belongs what He has given, and everything with Him has an appointed term. So be patient and seek reward.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would say this to console the bereaved, reminding them that all matters are with Allah and to be patient seeking His reward. (Sahih al-Bukhari 1284)

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
items.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem

translation.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: I know a word which, if he were to say it, what he feels would go away. If he says: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem, it would go away from him. (Sahih al-Bukhari 3282, Sahih Muslim 2610)

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin

translation.en: There is no deity except You, exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: No Muslim ever says this concerning any matter except that Allah answers it. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3505)

items.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
items.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakeel

translation.en: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

virtues.en: Ibrahim (عليه السلام) said this when he was thrown into the fire, and Allah made the fire cool and safe for him. The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever says it in a matter that concerns him, Allah suffices him in that matter. (Sahih al-Bukhari 3861)

title.ar: بسم الله الذي لا يضر مع اسمه شيء

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-samai wa huwas-sami`ul-`aleem

translation.en: In the Name of Allah, with Whose Name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever recites this, nothing will harm him. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3388, Sunan Abi Dawud 5088)

title.en: Seeking Refuge from Grief and Sorrow

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَاتِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-`ajzi wal-kasal, wal-jubni wal-bukhli, wa dal`id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from grief and sorrow, from weakness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and the domination of men.

reference.collection: Sunan Abi Dawud 5090, Sunan Ibn Majah 3883

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) used to teach his companions this comprehensive dua. (Sunan Abi Dawud 5090, Sunan Ibn Majah 3883)

title.en: Seeking Refuge from the Removal of Blessings

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min zawali ni'matik, wa tahawwuli `afiyatik, wa fuja'ati niqmatik, wa jami'i sakhatik

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the removal of Your blessing, the change of Your well-being, the suddenness of Your punishment, and from all of Your displeasure.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) made this dua in every prayer. (Sahih Muslim 2734)

title.en: Dua for Paradise and Refuge from Fire

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-jannah, wa a'udhu bika minan-nar

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek Your refuge from the Fire.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever asks Allah for Paradise three times, Paradise will say: O Allah, admit him. And whoever seeks refuge from the Fire three times, the Fire will say: O Allah, save him. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 2572)

title.en: Dua for Parents: Mercy as They Raised You

items.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi rhamhuma kama rabbayani sagheeran

translation.en: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.

virtues.en: A Quranic dua that beautifully parallels the mercy parents showed in raising their child. Part of the comprehensive guidance in Surah Al-Isra about treating parents with excellence.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir li wa li-walidayya wal-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day the account is established.

virtues.en: A dua of Ibrahim (عليه السلام) that the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) also used, extending forgiveness to parents and all believers.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ
items.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li wa li-walidayya

translation.en: O Allah, forgive me and my parents.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would frequently make dua for his parents after their passing, showing that dua for parents continues even after death. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi)

title.en: Seeking Refuge from a Bad Neighbor

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَارِ السُّوءِ فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ، فَإِنَّ الْجَارَ الْبَارَّ إِذَا شَاهَدَ خَيْرًا أَعَانَهُ، وَإِذَا رَأَىٰ سُوءًا سَتَرَهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min jari-s-su'i fi daril-muqamah, fa-innal-jaral-barra idha shahada khayran a'anahu, wa idha ra'a su'an satarahu

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a bad neighbor in my permanent dwelling, for the righteous neighbor, when he sees good, he assists, and when he sees evil, he covers it.

virtues.en: Islam places great emphasis on good neighborly relations. This dua seeks Allah's protection from a harmful neighbor and implicitly asks for a righteous one.

items.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: Dhahabaz-zama'u wa-abtallatil-'uruq wa thabatal-ajru insha Allah

translation.en: Thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would say this upon breaking his fast. (Sunan Abi Dawud 2357)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَعَلَىٰ رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma laka sumtu wa `ala rizqika aftartu

translation.en: O Allah, for You I have fasted, and upon Your provision I have broken my fast.

virtues.en: A beautiful dua affirming that the fast was solely for Allah and the breaking of fast is through His provision. (Sunan Abi Dawud 2358)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
items.transliteration: Bismillah, Allahumma jannibnash-shaytana wa jannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana

translation.en: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the Shaytan away from us and keep the Shaytan away from what You provide us.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: If one of you says this before intimacy, and a child is decreed from that act, no Shaytan will ever harm that child. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5285, Sahih Muslim 1434)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Allahummaghfir lahu warhamhu, wa `afihi wa `fu `anhu, wa akrim nuzulah, wa wassi' mudkhalah, waghislihil-ma'a wath-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqihu minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa abdilhu daran khayran min darihi, wa ahalan khayran min ahlihi, wa zawjan khayran min zawjihi, wa adkhihil-jannah, wa a'idhu min `adhabil-qabri wa `adhabin-nar

translation.en: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy upon him, give him well-being and pardon him, honor his arrival, widen his entrance, wash him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him from sins as a white garment is purified from filth. Replace for him a home better than his home, a family better than his family, and a spouse better than his spouse. Admit him into Paradise and protect him from the torment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) taught this dua to be recited in the funeral prayer. For a female, replace pronouns accordingly. (Sahih Muslim 963)

items.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَلَاحِقُونَ، نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
items.transliteration: As-salamu `alaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu'minina wal-muslimin, wa inna insha Allahu bikum lalahiqun, nas'alullaha lana wa lakumul-`afiyah

translation.en: Peace be upon you, O people of the dwellings, from among the believers and the Muslims. Indeed, if Allah wills, we will join you. We ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would visit the graveyard and give this salam to the deceased, teaching that the dead can hear the greeting. (Sahih Muslim 974, Sahih al-Bukhari 1327)

title.en: Dua When Lowering the Deceased into the Grave
title.ar: الدعاء عند وضع الميت في القبر

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَىٰ مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi wa `ala millati rasulillahi sallallahu `alayhi wa sallam

translation.en: In the name of Allah and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وسلم).

virtues.en: This is said when placing the deceased into the grave, affirming that the deceased followed the way of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم). Then one makes dua: O Allah, so-and-so is in Your protection and the rope of Your neighborhood, so protect him from the trial of the grave and the punishment of the Fire. (Sahih Muslim 863, Sunan Abi Dawud 3202)

title.en: Dua for Good in This World and the Next

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan, wa fil-akhirati hasanatan, wa qina `adhaban-nar

translation.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

virtues.en: One of the most frequently recited duas of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم), encompassing all needs of this life and the next. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6389)

title.en: Dua for the Night of Decree (Laylatul Qadr)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
items.transliteration: Allahumma innaka `afuwwun tuhibbul-`afwa fa `fu `anni

translation.en: O Allah, You are the Pardoner, You love to pardon, so pardon me.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) taught Aisha to say this when seeking Laylatul Qadr in the last ten nights of Ramadan. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3513)

items.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi zidni `ilma

translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

virtues.en: The dua of Musa (عليه السلام) in the Quran (20:114), a powerful and concise prayer seeking beneficial knowledge from Allah.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim `ala nabiyyina Muhammad

translation.en: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever sends one blessing upon me, Allah will send ten blessings upon him. (Sahih Muslim 408)

title.en: Last Two Verses of Al-Baqarah Upon Waking

items.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ۞ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا ۚ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ۚ وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Amanar-rasulu bima unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu'minun, kullun amana billahi wa mala'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi, la nafarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulihi, wa qalu sami'na wa ata'na, ghufiranaka rabbana wa ilaykal-masir. La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha, laha ma kasabat wa `alayha maktasabat, rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na, rabbana wa la tahmil `alayna isran kama hamaltahu `alalladhina min qablina, rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih, wa `fu `anna, waghfir lana, warhamna, anta mawlana fansurna `alal-qawmil-kafirin

translation.en: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, saying, "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. Your forgiveness, our Lord. And to You is the final destination." Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear. It will have what it has earned, and it will be responsible for what it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not burden us with that which You have not burdened upon those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with that which we have no capacity to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

virtues.en: Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him. (Sahih al-Bukhari 4009)

items.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
items.transliteration: Ashhadu alla ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluh

translation.en: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.

virtues.en: Affirming the shahadah upon waking is a sunnah that renews one's faith and reminds the believer of their purpose.
